examples.detection_method: Automated cloud security posture management (CSPM) tools scan S3 bucket policies and detect wildcard '*' principals with GetObject permissions. CloudTrail monitoring flags anonymous calls to sensitive buckets. Network IDS inspects AWS CLI user agents from unusual IPs. Periodic manual audits and use of AWS Config rules to flag non-compliant bucket policies.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
